assistant.title: AI Console
assistant.subtitle: Say it in plain words: research, render tasks, drafts and publishing are all handled here, with every step reported back.
assistant.placeholder: e.g. Look up the latest news about brand X and make a 30s vertical short
assistant.hint: Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line

empty.title: Start from a goal
empty.description: Describe the outcome; it breaks the work into steps. Pick a line below, tweak it, then send.

prompts.tweak: Make the subtitles on that last cut bigger and use a calmer voice-over
prompts.publish: Then publish it to Douyin and Xiaohongshu

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.firstRun: Connect a model: endpoint, key, model name.
